prompt:
Architectural floor plan of one room, drawn straight from above as a clean top-down orthographic plan view in the style of a set designer's ground plan: white background, thick dark walls with gaps for doors and windows, door swings drawn as arcs, windows as thin double lines, and every piece of furniture as a simple outline from above, to scale. In the plan, its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall, as the establishing view names them. Draw only the doors, windows and openings the description names. Location: Street outside the jail. A quiet present-day city street outside a jail, in bright daylight. Back side: a tall chain-link fence topped with coils of razor wire, and behind it the blocky grey concrete jail building with narrow slit windows. A steel pedestrian gate in the fence, opposite the camera, is the way out of the jail. A wide grey concrete sidewalk runs along the fence, and the curb runs parallel to it across the frame, with an empty parking lane of dark asphalt in front of it. Left side: the road and the fence stretch away into the distance, with a streetlamp at the curb. Right side: the sidewalk continues past a row of young trees and a bus-stop pole. Front side (behind the camera): the far lane of the road and low buildings opposite. Sunlight falls from high on the left and casts short shadows to the right; the sky is clear.

Avoid: people, text, labels, numbers, letters, dimensions, compass, logos, watermark, a door or window the description does not name.
